task: Bounded feedback retrieval policy; not multi-hop QA
model_selection: Read frozen results/selection.json; winner chosen solely on validation

bm25.tokenization: lowercase latin/cyrillic/digit tokens length>=2; NLTK Russian Snowball without external downloads

fusion: RRF k=60 across top20 for each search; ties docid lexical
lexical_control: Same max3 tool-call budget: original, then original+top2 new title terms from last top5; rank-weighted frequency 1/rank; deterministic lexical ties; Russian question stopwords removed.
invalid_policy: stop with explicit status; retain actual previous search results; no repair/retry or per-query positive insertion

metrics.ndcg10: binary qrels; ideal from all positives for the query
metrics.recall10: positives retrieved in top10 divided by all judged positives
metrics.mrr: reciprocal first relevant rank within available returned list (original<=20; fusion<=60)
metrics.mrr10: reciprocal first relevant rank capped at10
metrics.judged_coverage10: fraction of top10 hits with an explicit qrel

unjudged_policy: TREC convention: unjudged=0; judgments are incomplete. Report judged coverage; missing labels are not verified negatives.

few_shot_examples.query: Когда были проведены первые Олимпийские игры?
Кто начал собирать коллекцию Кунсткамеры Санкт-Петербурга??

limitations: Restricted 41007-passage judged-pool corpus; not full-corpus MIRACL.
The fixed corpus was constructed from official train/dev judgment pools, including application topics.
MIRACL provides no golden multi-step trajectories; additional calls are not evidence of multi-hop reasoning.
